profile.summary: A systems integrator based in the San Francisco Bay Area that designs, installs and maintains communications and security systems, such as nurse call, access control, video surveillance, structured cabling and school intercom and bell systems. It serves healthcare, education and commercial customers. It has operated since 1982 and was acquired by Beacon Communications, Inc. in April 2022.
